answer: Identity stays non-fakeable only when every agent's voting weight is welded to a costly, externally rooted stake. First condition: registration burns a ferrous hardware token whose serial is signed by a manufacturer quorum, so spawning ten thousand wallets costs ten thousand physical chips. Second: stake matures through a pearl-like layered history, each layer co-signed by prior peers, so a hollow shell identity with no real work cannot inherit weight. Sybils pay full price per node or stay weightless.
